description: Download a binary Google Drive file (PDF, image, zip, Office doc, etc.) into blob storage and return its file_blob_key, along with the file name and mime type. Google-native docs (Docs/Sheets/Slides) cannot be downloaded this way — use the matching export verb instead. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Fetch the bytes of a binary Drive file and persist them to platform blob storage, returning a file_blob_key reference (not the bytes themselves) plus name and mime type. Handles arbitrary binary files via Drive's get_media. Google-native document types (application/vnd.google-apps.*) are rejected with a pointer to docs_export / sheets_export / slides_export because native docs must be exported, not downloaded. The returned file_blob_key can be attached to email or handed to other plugins. Fails gsuite.not_found if the id does not exist.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with file_blob_key (a blob-storage reference to the downloaded bytes), name, and mime.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the file was downloaded and give its name. The file_blob_key references potentially sensitive corporate content — surface it for downstream use but do not treat it as public.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Download a binary Drive file into blob storage.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id, or the file is a Google-native doc that must be exported. gsuite.not_found: the id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: pass a valid binary-file id, or use the export verb for native docs. gsuite.not_found: the file may have been deleted. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
